This produces a uv-based image with the `demospipes_api` package installed.

### demospipes-base-executors

```bash
docker build \
  -t demospipes-base-executors:latest \
  -f 02-backend/demospipes/core/Dockerfile \
  02-backend/demospipes/core
```

This produces a Prefect-based image (`prefecthq/prefect:3.7.4-python3.12`) with the `demospipes_core` package installed.

## Step 2: Build the addons

The addon Dockerfiles reference the base images by name. Update the `FROM` lines in each addon Dockerfile to match the tags you used above (e.g. `demospipes-base-api:latest`).

### addons/bmds/api

```bash
docker build \
  -t demospipes-addon-api:latest \
  -f 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/api/Dockerfile \
  02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds
```

### addons/bmds/executors

```bash
docker build \
  -t demospipes-addon-executors:latest \
  -f 02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/executors/Dockerfile \
  02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds
```

## Other components

`demospipes/data-structures` is a shared Python package used as a dependency by the services above. It is not a standalone container.
